Atelier Chaloub Architectes (ACA) is seeking a full-time Junior Architectural Designer or Candidate for the Profession of Architect
to support innovative concepts and research. We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented candidate with 1–2 years of professional experience and a degree in architecture from an accredited program. This entry-level position offers an excellent opportunity for an enthusiastic graduate or emerging designer to gain hands-on experience and grow their career within the industry.
About Us
With over 35 years of experience, Atelier Chaloub Architectes (ACA) is a Montreal-based architectural firm recognized for its extensive portfolio of renowned residential projects in Montreal and its surrounding areas. Our collaborative, team-oriented approach fosters a dynamic environment that inspires creativity and innovation. At ACA, we value professional growth and offer opportunities to gain experience across various project types. To learn more about us, visit our website at https://www.acarchitectes.com/
